name: Himitsu Kareshi - Idol Hitotsu Yane no Shita
original_name: 秘密彼氏 アイドルひとつ屋根の下
source:
The company you were working for suddenly went bankrupt. You’ve lost your job and have been put in a difficult situation…but someone appears in front of you is the popular idol star you have always seen on TV!

He takes you to an apartment called ‘Cloud Reveur’; a place in which only idol stars are allowed to live. All of a sudden, you’ve been offered a job there as a manager…

Your life as the manager and housemate of these suspicious idol stars has begun! Do they have a secret and unexpected affair that you’ve never seen on TV?

[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/103651364921/the-idol-dormitory-%E7%A7%98%E5%AF%86%E5%BD%BC%E6%B0%8F-%EF%BD%B1%EF%BD%B2%EF%BE%84%EF%BE%9E%EF%BE%99%E3%81%B2%E3%81%A8%E3%81%A4%E5%B1%8B%E6%A0%B9%E3%81%AE%E4%B8%8B]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
你工作的公司突然破产。你失去工作，陷入困境……但一直在电视上见到的人气偶像明星竟出现在你面前！

他带你来到“Cloud Reveur”公寓，只有偶像明星才获准住在那里。转眼间，你得到了一份管理公寓的工作……

作为这些可疑偶像明星的经理与室友，你的新生活开始了！他们是否隐藏着从未在电视上展现的秘密而意外的关系？
